Extract concepts for one source

Source: R/pipeline.R
run_concepts.Rd

Create source-specific concept tables from packaged definitions, supplemental concept definitions, and user or external SQL. Select one or more layers with layers; by default, all enabled layers are processed.

Usage

run_concepts(
  src_name,
  db_name = NULL,
  base_dir = NULL,
  engine = c("postgres", "duckdb"),
  user_concepts = NULL,
  user_schema = NULL,
  external_sql_dir = NULL,
  external_schema = NULL,
  concept_name = NULL,
  dry_run = FALSE,
  layers = NULL,
  rm_duplicates = TRUE,
  concepts = NULL
)

Arguments

src_name

Character string identifying the source.

db_name

Character string naming the PostgreSQL database. If NULL, use the active project configuration, falling back to "rendehr". Ignored when engine = "duckdb".

base_dir

Character string giving the project directory, or NULL to resolve it from the active project configuration and working directory.

engine

Character string, "postgres" or "duckdb". Default: "postgres". DuckDB uses the source database path returned by ehr_paths().

user_concepts

Character string giving a supplemental concept CSV. A concept defined there replaces all packaged rows with the same source and concept name; other packaged concepts are kept unchanged. The file must exist. If NULL, use a configured supplemental file when available.

user_schema

Character string naming the target schema for user SQL. NULL uses the source concepts schema.

external_sql_dir

Character string giving an external SQL directory. NULL uses the external-concept directory returned by ehr_paths().

external_schema

Character string naming the target schema for a single external module. NULL derives the schema from the module name. Separate submodules always receive separate schemas.

concept_name

Character vector of concept names or filenames without .sql. Filters the flat, ts, dur, and user layers; NULL includes all concepts in those layers. The ehr and external layers are not filtered.

dry_run

Logical. If TRUE, prepare concept SQL without building concept tables or registering provenance. Default: FALSE. See Details for database connection and file-writing behavior.

layers

Character vector of layer names from the table below, or NULL to run all enabled layers. Layers run in the listed order, and required input tables must already exist.

rm_duplicates

Logical. Remove chart rows that are validated copies of lab results (MIMIC) or of monitor values (eICU) in the ts and dur layers, and repeated chart rows of a ts concept (see run_atomic_concepts_unified()). Default TRUE. FALSE extracts exactly the same rows and removes none.

concepts

Named list from concept_options() or an ordinary named list of concept options. A setting cannot be supplied both here and as a direct argument, even if the values are equal.

Value

Invisibly, a named list of results for layers that processed at least one concept or file. In an executing run, each element is a named logical vector indicating success (TRUE) or failure (FALSE). For a dry run, the flat, ts, dur, and user elements are named character vectors of SQL; ehr and external report SQL adaptation success as logical vectors. Execution failures raise an error instead of returning a completed result.

Details

The source's cohort and required observation-window tables must already exist. The function opens and closes its own database connection.

LayerDefinitionsOutput
flatPackaged SQLSource concepts schema
tsTime-series definitions from CSVSource concepts schema
durDuration definitions from CSVSource concepts schema
ehrMaintained derived-concept SQLSource derived schema
userProject SQLSource concepts schema or user_schema
externalExternal SQL modulesModule-specific schemas

Upstream repo SQL is reference material and is not an executable layer.

The time-series and duration SQL generators support PostgreSQL and DuckDB. Other SQL must be compatible with the selected engine. The ehr layer requires PostgreSQL: it is skipped in a default DuckDB run, and explicitly requesting it with DuckDB raises an error.

A dry run still opens a database connection, may initialize schemas, and writes generated time-series or duration SQL files to the configured output directories. It does not build concept tables. Reported SQL failures in an executing run are collected and raised together after the selected layers have been attempted.

See also

concept_options(), run_one_source(), run_flat_sql_concepts(), run_atomic_concepts_unified(), run_external_concepts()

Examples

selected <- concept_options(layers = c("flat", "ts"))

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Requires an existing cohort and configured database connection.
run_concepts("mimic_iv_demo", base_dir = "project", layers = "flat")
run_concepts("mimic_iv_demo", base_dir = "project", concepts = selected)
} # }
